in_sanskrit.name: Vn
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victory, Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vn एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vn is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijay' which means 'victory'. It is also associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who represents power and preservation. The name conveys a sense of strength, courage and triumph.
